final: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share FROM invoice_counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - st.average_share) AS average_excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN stats AS st WHERE s.share > st.average_share
